environment.description: Same application code deployed in an ECS Fargate task. The task definition specifies a custom seccomp profile loaded via the 'seccompProfile' field (type: Localhost, localhostProfile pointing to the profile baked into the AMI at /etc/seccomp/restricted.json). This profile operates in SCMP_ACT_ERRNO mode for the execve, execveat, and fork/vfork/clone syscalls EXCEPT for a narrow allowlist of binary paths enforced via seccomp-bpf arg inspection (only /usr/local/bin/wkhtmltopdf and /usr/bin/python3 are permitted as argv[0] targets for execve). Additionally, the Fargate task runs with a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true) with only /tmp mounted as a tmpfs with 'noexec' flag. The ECS task networking uses awsvpc mode with a security group that only allows inbound on port 5000 from the ALB security group.

config.seccomp_profile_summary: SCMP_ACT_ERRNO default for execve/execveat/clone/fork/vfork; SCMP_ACT_ALLOW conditional rules: execve permitted only when arg0 matches /usr/local/bin/wkhtmltopdf or /usr/bin/python3 (BPF string comparison on first 32 bytes of filename argument)
config.networking: awsvpc, SG inbound 5000 from ALB SG only
config.iam_task_role: minimal (no S3, no SSM, logs:PutLogEvents only)
